info.title: AI Bid/No-Bid & Capability Matcher API
info.description: High-performance, stateless GovCon & Enterprise B2B Capture Intelligence microservice. Compares raw RFP, Statement of Work (SOW), or Sources Sought solicitation text against a vendor's capability statement and past performance profile to compute a 0-100 Probability of Win (Pwin) score, granular 4-dimension fit breakdown, knockout disqualifier warnings, requirement-by-requirement gap remediation, subcontracting/teaming strategy, and a Shipley-aligned Executive Summary pitch.

post.summary: Evaluate RFP Bid/No-Bid Pwin score, capability gaps & tailored capture pitch
post.description: Compares raw RFP, SOW, or Sources Sought text against a vendor's capability statement and past performance profile. Returns a 0-100 Probability of Win (Pwin) score, granular dimension scoring (technical fit, past performance, clearances/certifications, set-aside eligibility), knockout disqualifiers, requirement-by-requirement gap remediation, subcontracting/teaming strategy, and a Shipley-aligned Executive Summary pitch.

200.description: Successfully generated Bid/No-Bid Pwin scorecard, gap analysis, and tailored executive pitch.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Payload validation failure or LLM schema extraction failure.

502.description: Bad Gateway - Upstream LLM inference provider error.

get.description: Unprotected health check endpoint for marketplace SLA monitoring.

PursuitRoleStrategy.description: Preferred pursuit posture to evaluate: 'prime_contractor', 'subcontractor_or_jv', or 'either_prime_or_sub'.

BidRecommendation.description: Executive gate decision: STRONG_BID, CONDITIONAL_BID_TEAMING_REQUIRED, HIGH_RISK_STRETCH_BID, or NO_BID.

RequirementAlignmentStatus.description: Vendor alignment level: FULL_MATCH, PARTIAL_MATCH, or CRITICAL_GAP.

rfp_text.description: Raw text from the RFP, Statement of Work (SOW), Sources Sought notice, or solicitation summary.
rfp_text.example: SOLICITATION: DHS-CISA-2026-SOC-09. NAICS: 541512 ($34M Size Standard). Set-Aside: Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). Scope: The Contractor shall provide 24x7x365 Zero-Trust SOC Modernization, CrowdStrike Falcon EDR engineering, and Splunk SOAR automation across 25,000 endpoints. Mandatory Qualifications: Active Top Secret Facility Clearance (FCL), ISO 27001 certification, CMMC Level 2 compliance, and at least two (2) prior federal cybersecurity contracts valued at $5M+ within the last 5 years. Cloud tools hosted by vendor must be FedRAMP High authorized.

company_capability_statement.description: Vendor capability statement, past performance summary, clearances, socioeconomic designations, and core competencies.
company_capability_statement.example: Apex Cyber Defense LLC — Certified SDVOSB & SBA Small Business (UEI: K9M2X4P8L1Q2). Clearances & Certs: Secret Facility Clearance (FCL), ISO 27001:2022 Certified, CMMC Level 2 Ready. Core Capabilities: 24x7x365 Managed Detection & Response (MDR), CrowdStrike Falcon & Splunk Enterprise Security SOAR engineering, Zero-Trust Architecture. Past Performance: (1) U.S. Coast Guard SOC Support ($6.8M, 2023-present, 18,000 endpoints); (2) VA Enterprise SIEM/SOAR Modernization ($5.4M, 2022-2025). Partnered with AWS GovCloud (FedRAMP High).

vendor_evidence_matched.example: Holds Secret Facility Clearance (FCL); lacks Top Secret FCL.

gap_remediation_or_teaming_action.example: Execute a Teaming Agreement with a Top Secret-cleared subcontractor for classified task areas or submit a Q&A question asking if Top Secret FCL can be satisfied by a cleared subcontractor/JV member.

solicitation_title.example: DHS-CISA-2026-SOC-09 Zero-Trust SOC Modernization & MDR/SOAR Support

recommended_pursuit_role.example: SDVOSB Prime Contractor with Top Secret-Cleared Subcontractor
